A particularly strong and very addictive painkiller capable of entirely nullifying one's pain. It is recommended that if one is to begin using this drug, they should become daily users, as withdrawal is extremely difficult to cope with and starts quickly.
Active opium in the bloodstream. Dulls out pain completely.
I feel no pain! Let's do this!
Because of an opium addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
A built-up tolerance to opium. The more severe this tolerance is, the more opium it takes to get the same effect.

A chemical addiction to opium. Long-term presence of opium has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug.
\nWithout regular doses of opium, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

These people have been here a very long time. Their civilization started as a gathering of tribes, but quickly developed skills such as writing, masonry and civil service. 

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the Republic can be dangerous enemies and valuable friends because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular part of the Republic holds production and city development in high regards. Gaining their support will unlock several perks focused on improving the wellbeing of the people.

subject_story->revived the ancient art of meat drying, securing sustenance and delighting palates with flavors honed by time
subject_gerund->extending the bounty of the hunt through the wisdom of the ancients
Build excellent stone mosaics, utilising different colours and shapes to express beauty. Slow to construct.
subject_story->crafted stone mosaics that capture the essence of beauty and narrative through color and form
subject_gerund->embedding the story of a people in the very stones that pave their path

subject_story->constructed thermaebaths, communal havens of relaxation and warmth powered by the earth's breath
subject_gerund->fostering communal well-being and intimacy in the embrace of nature's warmth
Perform various plays on the theatre stage as a recreational activity.
subject_story->revived the timeless arts of drama and comedy, enriching the soul of the republic through performance and play
subject_gerund->mirroring the human condition, from tragedy to farce, on the communal stage
Mix steel with stone chunks to create slightly weaker metal in large quantities.
subject_story->discovered the alchemy of combining steel with stone to produce bronze, marking the dawn of a new era in metallurgy
subject_gerund->ushering in an age where metal becomes the backbone of progress and power
Build a workbench for crafting simple things like clubs or bows.

subject_gerund->laying the groundwork for enduring structures and monuments with the strength of cement

subject_story->conceived the wood-fired crematorium, a testament to dealing with the departed in a manner that respects both cultural customs and sanitation needs

subject_gerund->weaving the fabric of society with colors that command respect and admiration
Construct paths, dirt roads and stone roads directly on the world map, allowing for faster caravan travel.

subject_gerund->tracing the arteries of trade and communication with each road built, propelling the civilization forward

subject_gerund->equipping the legions with a diverse armory for conquest and defense
Create heavy armor of legionaries, capable of withstanding a high degree of sharp damage.
subject_story->crafted heavy armor that turns warriors into indomitable forces on the battlefield, capable of withstanding the fiercest strikes
subject_gerund->donning the legionnaires in armor that weaves invincibility with the threads of war

subject_gerund->clothing the ranks of leadership in armor befitting their valor and virtue

Squabbling in the senate and cutthroat politics left you with distaste for anything regarding the will of the people. You deserve so much more - as your blood is royal and your wreath is golden. You gathered a few of the senators that sided with you and left the comforts of the Republic. It is time you unite them on your terms, under your rule. Glory to the empire. Glory to the Emperor! 
Note: Since you start being hostile to the Republic factions, this is a difficult scenario.
A gathering of nobility with a grand purpose. A default Classical experience.

Neron Neolithic believes that to be worthy, one needs to be tested in fire. He will bombard you with a constant stream of threats and only give you a short moment to catch your breath, before striking you once again.
Bronze tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build.

A small, personal tent no larger than a single person bed. When pitched, such a tent will easily protect a pawn from elements such as heat or cold, however it’s not quite as restful, as one is still laying directly on the ground.

A very large, heated stone bath meant to be shared by several patrons. Provides a temporary respite from an otherwise discomforting world. When in high numbers, bathers are known to lose themselves in the moment and share more than they normally would.

A lightly decorated wooden stage meant to provide area for props and actors both to create compelling scenes. Such performances are quite fun for both those on stage and those casting their eyes upon it.

A large pile of wood placed carefully utop a tall platform. Once lit, a slow burning fire will burn brightly for 3 days. Lighting such a beacon will signal to a friendly faction that your settlement is in need of help, auxiliary military engineers usually arrive shortly afterwards, they will both fight and build alongside you. Must be fully rebuilt after extinguishing. Help can only be requests once at a time, and only every 3 days.

A solid wooden rack featuring a series of dangling metal hooks across a central beam meant to hang slabs of meat. Meat hung by it will very slowly air dry over time, allowing an indefinite form of preservation. The air drying process can be quickened by a warm environment.
A simple bench stocked with equally simple tools meant to assist in the crafting of primitive goods and weapons.
A wood fired receptacle meant for disposal of unneeded junk or bodies.
A very strong, open stone basin meant to cure and shape a mixture of clay, sand, and powdered stone known as cement into blocks.

A large wooden enclosure meant to be placed in shallow water and filled with cloth. A unique breed of snails found in many rimworlds are known to wash up and leave residue on the cloth contained within, dying it. Creates a small amount of royal fabric over time.
A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
A sturdy unpowered cooler notably larger than the traditional variety, cools rooms to freezing via water evaporation. Will run out and self-destruct after several days.

A thin square box made of stone, perforated with tiny holes at the bottom and top. A small fire can be lit and sustained within. The stone container will slowly dissipate heat, allowing prolonged passive warmth.
Salty, chewy, thinly-sliced meat that will last indefinitely and tastes quite pleasant for what it is.
A metallic alloy made from steel and trace amounts of copper found in stones. Can be used for crafting armor or furnishings when steel is in low supply.

Sturdy, utilitarian cement blocks for crafting any sort of infrastructure. While not as durable as granite or as gorgeous as marble, it is a clear improvement over weaker materials such as slate or sandstone.
A bolt of very beautiful and luxurious violet cloth, perfect for clothing the distinguished.
A polished metallic piece of headgear resembling laurels meant to signify wealth and status, equally appealing to both senators and nobles.
A carefully designed helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication.

A carefully designed and decorated helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication. This particular helmet includes accoutrement to inspire both its wearers and onlookers, when fighting side by side a centurion even pain itself seems dulled.

A semicircular, open-bottomed garment designed to cover the entire body and shoulders. While similar to tribal clothing the toga is generally made with a more delicate touch and presents itself as dignified everyday wear.

A carefully designed set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.

A carefully designed and decorated set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.
Toggle buffing nearby allies, turn off when not in combat if performance is a concern
A heavily fortified square shield that covers one's body from shin to shoulder, heavy enough to slow those wielding it at the benefit of incredible protection.
A tiny, crimson flower that can be harvested for opium, a strong pain killing drug.
I have to seize the day, for it can always be my last!

Places a temporary, autonomously-led camp that specializes in sowing and harvesting easily-grown vegetation, cannot be placed on deserts. Once an ample amount is collected, a delivery will be made at the outskirts of a faction's primary colony.

Places a temporary, autonomously-led camp that specializes in hunting and butchering wildlife. Once an ample amount is collected, a delivery will be made at the outskirts of a faction's primary colony.

Places a temporary, autonomously-led camp that specializes in collecting wood from trees in the areas, cannot be placed on deserts. Once an ample amount is collected, a delivery will be made at the outskirts of a faction's primary colony.

Places a temporary, autonomously-led camp that specializes in collecting and processing stone or metal, can only be placed on hills or mountains. Once an ample amount is collected, a delivery will be made at the outskirts of a faction's primary colony.
A weighty shortsword meant to deliver piercing attacks as well as occasional slashing swipes. Many scholars consider such a weapon to be a slightly less effective precursor to the longsword.
A simple, elongated knife capable of being swung quite quickly. Generally favored by assassins or used as a backup weapon should one be separated from their spear or spatha.
A long-tipped throwing spear specifically designed to break armor and shield alike.
A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
